title: Jango Fett
subtitle: Bounty Hunter
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: In the era prior to the Clone Wars, Jango Fett was the most prominent and feared bounty hunter in the galaxy. Fett served as the genetic template used by the Kaminoans in their creation of the clone army. Fett requested an unaltered clone for himself to raise as a son. During the skirmish on Geonosis, Jango working as Count Dooku's bodyguard, was killed by Mace Windu.
